text:
carol: Follow-up: bandwidth-constrained sites keep causing long apply windows. Proposal: staged-prefetch windows that pull required blobs ahead of activation and a backpressure token for operator to limit concurrent applies. Thoughts?

jess: sounds good. need to handle partial prefetch tooif prefetch stops mid-way (network hiccup) we must not mark patchlet as in-progress. maybe a three-state prefetch: queued -> partial -> ready.

kai: partial state should include progress hash list so resume is integrity-checked. example: prefetch-progress: [sha256:aa1, sha256:bb2,...]

carol: agree. and add a prefetch TTL so we don't hold disk forever. TTL policy: default 48h, configurable per-epoch.

ops-bot: NOTICE: build #460 prefetch-daemon image pushed to registry.

devin: operator backpressure token: operator grants N tokens from cluster controller; each node consumes 1 token to start apply. controller monitors network + disk IO and adjusts N. if low tokens, console should show "prefetch queued" not "apply pending" to avoid false alarms.

jess: for rollback: if apply fails mid-activation we should try to resume using prefetched blobs first. if blobs missing, fall back to archive mirror. also add a retry budget per-object to avoid thundering.

kai: retry budget idea: per-object retries = 3, exponential backoff, and a global cap per-node to avoid saturating mirror.

carol: signing note: prefetch manifest must include patchlet->blob map + expiry + signature to avoid stale blobs being used. use manifest.sig and manifest.expiry fields.

devin: UX: surface three console states: "prefetching (x%)", "ready to activate", "apply in-progress". expose cancel prefetch in UI.

jess: compat: older operators without prefetch support should still accept patchlets; controller will revert to on-demand fetch and reduce tokens so we don't overload them. add capability flag in epoch manifest.

carol: action items: update RFC w/ prefetched blob manifest + token backpressure + retry-budget + TTL; add tests simulating network partition during prefetch and apply. I'll draft and ping QA.

ops-bot: TEST: added prefetch partition test to CI (job #77) :white_check_mark:

kai: one more: metric names for alerting: prefetch_success_rate, prefetch_latency_p50/p90, prefetch_disk_evictions. put them on infra SLO dashboard.

carol: good call. I'll add metrics and tie alerts to token shrink events.
